# La Casa della Pasta

> Italian Restaurant in Tampa, Florida. Homemade pasta and gnocchi, a pasta tossed tableside in a Parmesan wheel, and owners who stop by your table. Dinner Tuesday through Saturday.

- Phone: (813) 961-1012
- Address: 5273 Ehrlich Rd, Tampa, FL 33624
- Areas: Tampa, Temple Terrace, Carrollwood, Town 'n' Country, Gibsonton
- Offers: Pasta made in house; Seafood and sauces; Fresh pasta and gnocchi
- Rating: 4.5 from 750 Google reviews
